Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1557) Oct 14, 2026

  • The Edit Ref beside the conform. Choose the editor's movie of the cut (an MP4 or QuickTime) in the Conform window, or drop it there, and Compare Edit Ref (⌥⌘B) shows it beside the conform. It follows the cut from clip to clip, on the frame of the cut the conform is showing, so a wrong join or a slipped shot shows at a glance. It lines up by its timecode, or with the cut's first frame when it has none; Line up moves it a frame at a time. It is read as Rec.709 (or whatever you set on its side of the compare), kept with the session (choosing it or lining it up asks to be saved), and never sent to a review room.
  • The row the playhead is on. In the Conform window the row playing has a bar at its edge and a tint of its own, and keeps them when you click another row. The header says which shot of how many is playing, and the list no longer scrolls from under the pointer.
  • Retimes past 400% play to time. A conformed clip faster than 400% or slower than 5% plays in the time the cut gives it, as an edit application plays it.
  • A joined piece keeps its own ramp. When one of the events joined into a shot has a speed ramp of its own, its keys stay in the shot's speed line, so the plate's frame map has the right frame for every frame of the cut.
  • Open from Link no longer quits Asobi. A link that isn't a review is downloaded and opened as media; when the download ended, Asobi quit instead. A link that opens a web page (a share page, a sign-in) now says so, rather than opening nothing.
Earlier updates

1.0 (build 1476) Oct 12, 2026

  • DPX sequences play. 8, 10, 12 and 16-bit DPX files open and play like any other image sequence, read as the color space set for DPX in Settings, Color.
  • A tall floating Playlist with thumbnails could stop the app. Fixed.
  • Small fixes.

1.0 (build 1441) Oct 11, 2026

  • Network is in the Review menu. Review ▸ Network; it was under Window. It is also in the right-click Review menu.
  • A playlist on a network drive no longer slows the window. Whether each clip's file is there is checked in the background.
  • Locate Media… reads a folder in the background. A line above the toolbar says how far it has got.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1550) Oct 14, 2026

  • DaVinci Resolve and ARRI's tool, one job at a time. A pull and a camera raw develop no longer reach for Resolve or ARRI Reference Tool at the same moment: whichever asked first has it, and the other waits its turn. A waiting plate says Waiting for Resolve, the Pull Plates window says who has it, and Stop takes a waiting plate out of the line.
  • Optimize in the Queue window. Media ▸ Queue shows what is being optimized: Stop the shot being made (nothing of it is kept, and the next begins), Remove one that is waiting, and Try Again on any that didn't come out. A camera raw develop is listed there too, with its own Stop.
  • Stop one camera file, or Stop All. While camera raw is developing, the Queue window and the Conform window have Stop, for the file under way alone (nothing of it is kept, and the next begins), and Stop All. A file stopped is offered again by Develop….
  • ALEXA 35 camera raw is recognized. A real ALEXA 35 card labels its ARRIRAW differently from the Mini LF, and Asobi didn't take it for camera raw: it wasn't offered for developing, its plates didn't go to ARRI Reference Tool, and it wasn't read as LogC4. It is now.
  • For editorial, in the Conform report. A short section of questions to send to editorial with the cut: the events that look like one shot, and anything that couldn't be read from the cut file, each named by its Record TC.
  • A shot of two takes in the Conform report. Each take has its own line and its own sheet, as each has its own plate.
  • A cut read back from DaVinci Resolve stays tidied. With Tidy a cut with DaVinci Resolve, a saved session opened again no longer suggests joins on a cut that came back from Resolve.

Asobi Review 1.0 (build 1546) Oct 13, 2026

  • Reply to text written on the frame. Words typed on the picture with the Text tool are listed in the Notes sidebar, and now have a Reply field like any note, with the paperclip and the mic. The first reply gives the text its own thread, which goes to everyone in a review, to the report and to the exports. The words stay on the frame and are edited and removed there.
  • Input color space: remembered for the file, and Apply to All reaches every clip. A space you pick for a clip is now also remembered for that file on this Mac, so a Kitsu playlist opened again comes back with the QuickTime and the EXR each as you set them. Apply to All Movie Clips / Apply to All EXR Clips is in the Input picker itself, covers every timeline in the session, and sets the side of a clip that is off screen too: with the previews playing, it used to pass over the EXR behind each one.
  • Split at Playhead. One long event of a conformed cut that is two VFX shots: park on the frame that starts the second and choose Media ▸ Conformed Cut ▸ Split at Playhead. Each half is a shot of its own, with its own name and plate; select both and Join to undo.
  • The same take used again. A take that comes back later in a conformed cut is tagged Same take. Each shot gets its own plate by default; in Pull Plates, click PL01 on the later shot's row and choose Use that shot's Plate to write one plate for both.
  • Two takes in one shot. Events of different takes can be joined by hand into one shot (a split screen, a stitch between takes): it gets a plate for each take, PL01 then PL02 in the cut's order.
